nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
# FLUX.3 Klein Base + prompt upsampler

Drop an image onto Canvas. The upsampler reads the reference and the edit instruction. Canvas mask selects the edited region; empty mask edits the whole image.

Installed filename without _sd_ is BASE: 50 steps / CFG 3.5 / Euler / simple. The Flux.2-only sigma patch is disabled. Distilled _sd_ weights require a different recipe (16 steps / CFG 1). The upsampler is enabled and uses its own Qwen3.5 model. Start near 1 MP; the first load is slower.

https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy

## Full E2GO workflow

Select Manual or Wildcard in Powder Switcher. Main Prompt feeds Prompt List; each enabled slot creates a separate result. Wildcard count limits the lines per run. The LoRA loader is connected to model, encoder and prompt; add compatible LoRAs to its empty list. Duplicate LoRA rows are supported. Grid is connected but bypassed; enable it with Ctrl+B.

Powder Styler and Grid labels are connected. Use Final Prompt Preview to inspect the assembled caption and applied LoRA triggers.

## Local editing

1. Load the source in Canvas. 2. Select Brush and paint the area. 3. Enter the edit instruction. 4. Queue, review, then accept the result. An empty mask edits the whole image. ignore_mask temporarily allows full-frame editing without deleting your mask. stitch_blend=8 softens the boundary; 0 preserves pixels strictly outside the mask. Set batch_size in Canvas for multiple variants.

Keep Edit (native): the native encoder already supplies the reference. Standard Edit would add it twice. denoise=1 applies the full instruction. For ordinary img2img, open FULL - Img2Img; changing this mode does not disconnect the native encoder.

### Checked recipe
Flux 3 Klein Base: 50 steps, CFG 3.5, euler / simple. Sampler profile checks model and latent compatibility. Profiles do not select weights: Base, Turbo, Distilled and Edit checkpoints are not interchangeable. Use a fixed seed when comparing changes; increase size only after the prompt and composition work.

## Two-level enhancer
Original skips the language model; Enhanced uses Balanced or High detail instructions. Both instructions are editable. Manual and Wildcard share the same path. Styles and exact LoRA triggers are applied once AFTER enhancement; the language model cannot rewrite trigger tokens. Selected prompt preview shows the chosen branch; Final Prompt Preview shows the actual assembled caption. No reference is sent to the enhancer unless its image input is explicitly connected. For edits, preserve reference identifiers and do not infer unseen content. The existing Flux3 upsampler and reference image connection are retained.

## Canvas Layout
Open the Layout tab in Powder Canvas. Match generation size, describe the scene and regions, then enable Use layout. The layout connection is already wired. Layout is off by default. Object boxes are composition annotations, not visible frames. AI descriptions preserve every box and literal text; AI layout proposes a new composition for review. For cropped inpainting the layout must match the crop; disable layout when reusing an unrelated composition. MOSS exports actual-size centered pixel coordinates; Ideogram and FLUX.3 export normalized 0-1000 coordinates. FLUX.3 boxes describe target placement; source-to-target reference mapping is not exposed here. For FLUX.3 use Enhanced for the scene caption; leave Layout Scene blank to inherit it, or write a detailed scene in Layout. Your editor document is saved inside the workflow.

nodes.title: Enhancer instructions · Balanced
widgets_values:
You are a faithful visual prompt editor. Translate the request into English, preserving the exact subjects, species, counts, actions, relationships, colors, medium, viewpoint and exclusions. Translate nouns by meaning, never by sound. Preserve proper names and reference identifiers. Preserve explicitly requested visible lettering verbatim in its original language, in quotation marks. A subject name is not a request to print that name in the image.
Do not add unrequested people, animals, props, buildings, narrative events or text. Enrich the appearance of existing subjects, not the number of subjects. Style describes rendering, not new scene content. Do not impose photography, cinematic lighting, blur, bokeh, a color palette or a detailed background when unspecified. A plain background remains plain. Respect minimalist and simple styles. No empty quality boosters or prompt weighting syntax.
Describe visible facts only, never sounds, smells or imagined history. Do not add mist, fog or atmospheric haze unless requested. Do not introduce new exclusions such as "no sky visible". A named landscape has its requested surroundings; never replace those surroundings with a plain background. Plain backgrounds apply only when requested.
For an edit, preserve the exact requested change and invariants. Do not invent the contents of an unseen reference. Reference identifiers must remain unchanged. Negative requirements belong to the user's intent; do not turn excluded objects into positive scene details.
Return only the image prompt, without explanations, reasoning, Markdown or chat markers.

BALANCED: clarify ambiguous phrasing conservatively and add only useful visual detail. Usually 50-100 words; preserve a detailed request without needless expansion.

Target image model: Flux 3 Klein Base. Use one coherent final-image caption with explicit spatial layout. If a reference is supplied, incorporate the requested change and preserve its other visible attributes.

This is an edit workflow. Prioritize the requested modification and preservation constraints.
